title: How to Build a Feedback Tool Without Code (In Under 2 Hours)
summary: Build a custom product feedback tool — with voting, status tracking, and email notifications — without writing code. Canny costs $400/month. Yours costs $0.
body_markdown: Blink's hosting scales automatically. For a typical SaaS product with a few thousand active users, there's nothing to configure — it handles the traffic. For products with tens of thousands of daily active users, you'd want to add a database index on vote_count for the feedback table. Ask in Blink chat: "Add a database index on vote_count for the feedback table." One prompt, handled.
